🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +12.97%) while VXX falling (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -11.30%) BELOW TREND and sector breadth showing broad strength confirm risk-on bias.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.21% | 1M: -11.30%) ↓ falling BELOW TREND. Credit stress rising: HYG (1W: +0.06% | 1M: -0.23%) RECOVERY vs LQD (1W: -0.35% | 1M: -1.12%) BELOW TREND → HYG/LQD flagged CREDIT STRESS ↑.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-supportive: Dollar Strength Level (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +0.73%) → flat CORRECTION and Yield Curve (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -2.22%) → flat RECOVERY, while TLT (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -2.55%) is BELOW TREND.

📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Tech showing leadership on 1M but short-term pullback: XLK in CORRECTION (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +12.97%). Energy showing strength: XLE (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND and Financials showing relative strength on the week: XLF (1W: +1.43% | 1M: -1.00%) (style: Growth/Momentum leaning given XLK vs XLF strength).

5. US vs Global?
US equities mixed: SPY (1W: -0.73% | 1M: +4.43%) CORRECTION; Emerging markets muted: EEM (1W: -2.00% | 1M: +4.18%) CORRECTION and China soft: FXI (1W: -3.63% | 1M: -2.92%) BELOW TREND while Europe showing RECOVERY on regional cues.

6. Speculative Appetite?
Small-cap/speculative signals recovering: IWM (1W: -0.69% | 1M: +2.17%) CORRECTION and Speculation Index rising (1W: +1.81% | 1M: -4.46%) ↑ rising RECOVERY, but crypto/innovative ETFs remain weak: IBIT (1W: -4.70% | 1M: -1.68%) BELOW TREND and ARKK (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -3.38%) BELOW TREND.

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Industrial/metal signals mixed: CPER (1W: -3.60% | 1M: +2.61%) CORRECTION while gold weak: GLD (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.20%) BELOW TREND; copper/gold ratio ↑ rising ABOVE TREND suggests cyclical tilt despite short-term commodity pullback.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy showing breadth-backed strength: XLE (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND and crude BNO (1W: -1.16% | 1M: +9.95%) CORRECTION; natural gas UNG (1W: +1.52% | 1M: +3.47%) ABOVE TREND.

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Breadth (8/11) and VXX falling support the RISK-ON call; MAJOR divergence present as several large-cap growth ETFs (SPY, QQQ, XLK) show 1W weakness vs strong 1M gains — treat momentum carefully.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclical exposure showing strength, e.g., XLE (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND and industry/semis ETFs with strong 1M performance (SOXX 1W: -1.00% | 1M: +21.53% CORRECTION) while reducing exposure to defensive assets like GLD (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.20%) BELOW TREND and duration via TLT (1W: -0.82% | 1M: -2.55%) BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: Energy XLE (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +4.58%) ABOVE TREND and Semiconductors SOXX (1W: -1.00% | 1M: +21.53%) CORRECTION if 1W weakness stabilizes. BEARISH: Materials XME (1W: -4.62% | 1M: -5.28%) BELOW TREND and Metals PALL (1W: -3.83% | 1M: -10.37%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: Brent BNO (1W: -1.16% | 1M: +9.95%) CORRECTION on upside momentum. BEARISH: Gold GLD (1W: -2.39% | 1M: -4.20%) BELOW TREND and Silver SLV (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -1.31%) BELOW TREND.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD inflection ~0.80 (credit stress), Tech vs Financials level 3.45 (leadership gauge), SPY/TLT momentum cross around current flat corridor.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive, VXX falling and strong 1M tech/semis gains confirm risk bias. Energy and semiconductors showing relative strength while major 1W/1M divergences in large-cap growth (XLK/QQQ/SPY) are the key risk to monitor.
